verdict.rationale: There's a vague claim that S-1 drafts can be updated 'with a few simple prompts,' suggesting some natural-language interaction in Cooley's internal AI tooling, but there's no documentation of an actual natural-language command interface, chat UI, or API for end users across Cooley GO's document generators or Cooley AI. Probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI specs both 404, indicating no structured AI-native interface. Missing for 10: concrete product documentation of a natural-language command interface, examples of prompt-based interactions, API/agent integration support, and independent corroboration of this capability.
